trabajos.rufo: Rufo the Farmer: sunburnt middle-aged peasant man with a wide straw hat, short dark brown hair and stubble, blue linen shirt, holding a wooden hoe over his shoulder, worried honest face, golden wheat field at dusk blurred behind.
trabajos.matilde: Grandma Matilde: kind elderly village woman with grey-blonde hair in a bun, wrinkled smiling face, red wool shawl, carrying a wicker basket of bread and herbs, warm cottage kitchen light behind.
trabajos.bertin: Sergeant Bertin, village guard: stern weathered man with a short black beard, an old dented steel kettle helmet, grey padded gambeson with a small tabard, holding a spear, tired but loyal eyes, torchlit wall behind.
trabajos.pip: Pip, a village boy: cheerful freckled 10-year-old boy with messy auburn hair, green tunic, a wooden toy sword in his hand, big curious eyes and a gap-toothed grin, sunny village street blurred behind.
